changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[ResponsibilityDetail] AS select r.id as RuleID, r.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID, rresource.SecurityAssetID as ResourceID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as ResourceName, rresource.SecurityAsset, rresource.SecurityAssetID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as SecurityAssetName, r.Context, r.ApplyToType, rrel.PermissionsBitMask, r.IsVisible, NULL as OverrideID, A.Object, coalesce(A.ObjectID, 0) as ObjectID, A.Uid as AssetUid, r.Object as [Type], r.ObjectID as TypeID, RES.uid as ResourceUid, RES.uid as SecurityAssetUid from responsibilitytyperelationrule r inner join ResponsibilityTypeRelation rrel on (r.ResponsibilityTypeID = rrel.ResponsibilityTypeID and r.[Object] = rrel.[ObjectType] and r.ObjectID = rrel.ObjectID) inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (r.ID = rasset.RuleID) inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.ID = rresource.RuleID) inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID left join Asset A on ( (A.ID = rasset.AssetID) ) inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' where RES.State=1 union select r.id as RuleID, r.ResponsibilityTypeID as inner join ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = RG.ResourceID where RES.State=1 union select r.id as RuleID, r.ResponsibilityTypeID as rresource.SecurityAssetID inner join OrganizationResource RD on RD.OrganizationID = D.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = RD.ResourceID where RES.State=1 union select 0 as ResourceName, oride.SecurityAsset, oride.SecurityAssetID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as SecurityAssetName, oride.Context, cast(0 as bit) as ApplyToType, RR.PermissionsBitMask, cast(1 as bit) SecurityAssetUid from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'R' and RES.State = 1 union select 0 as RuleID, rr.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, oride.AssetID, att.ID as AssetTypeID, RES.ResourceID as ResourceID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as ResourceName, oride.SecurityAsset, oride.SecurityAssetID, G.[Name] as SecurityAssetName, oride.Context, cast(0 as bit) as ApplyToType, RR.PermissionsBitMask, cast(1 as bit) as IsVisible, oride.ID as OverrideID, A.Object, coalesce(A.ObjectID, 0) as ObjectID, A.Uid as AssetUid, ATT.Object as [Type], ATT.ObjectID as TypeID, RES.uid as ResourceUid, secasset.uid as SecurityAssetUid from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelation] RR on (att.[object] = RR.[objectType] and att.objectid = RR.[Objectid] and RR.ResponsibilityTypeID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID) inner join [Group] G on oride.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = oride.SecurityAssetID inner join [Asset] secasset ON secasset.[Object] = 'Group' AND secasset.ObjectID = oride.SecurityAssetID inner join ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = RG.ResourceID and RES.[State] = 1
